section.title: Community Support
section.p: pmMDA group provides community support, advices and development. All community activities are released under the Apache license and are available to all. The members of the group try hard to answer all open questions and requests in a timely manner.

The error tracking system is the standard one provided in Sourceforge. The forums are available for questions and extension requests. Please publish all your questions, enhacements, and error reports through the provided tracker tools. It allows all interested parties to have access to the discussion threads and current status of each request. The developers try to respond quickly to all pending demands.

section.title: Commercial Support
section.p: Commercial support is available for companies wishing extensive support, training and coaching activities. Commercial partners provide services in Europe.
Please send an email to the developers of pmMDA group at marcelbaumann@users.sourceforge.net

section.title: Sponsors
section.p: Companies and academical institutions are supporting the development of the pmMDA frameworks and the related projects.

tr.td: pmMDA.NET is a port of the pmMDA project to the .NET framework
